subject: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, Streaming, Tool Calling) - Draft
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Brown <ethan.brown@acmetech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, Streaming, Tool Calling) - Draft

Ethan —

Thanks again for a productive call today. Per our discussion, attached is a first-draft Mutual Action Plan milestone focused on the "Integration Build Plan" (SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs JSON schema). The goal is to align on owners, target dates, and any blockers so we can scope the POC and final production rollout. High level below and attached PDF has full milestone details.

Key milestone (Integration build):
- Scope: SDK integration (Python + JS), streaming (server->client streaming + token-level progress), tool calling hooks (external tool invocation + structured outputs JSON schema).
- Target completion: 2026-09-18 (target close for POC integration milestone)
- Owners:
  - Integration owner (technical, SDK): Rishi Malhotra (Redwood)
  - Partner engineering lead (Acme): Ethan Brown
  - Product/QA: Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood)
- Deliverables: SDK samples, streaming demo (websocket + server-sent events), tool-calling example (calendar lookup), reference structured-output schema and validation tests.
- Dependencies: Access to Acme sandbox account + API keys; network egress to Redwood dev endpoints; acceptance criteria doc signed off by Acme product.

Next steps:
1) Can you confirm Acme's internal owner for SDK acceptance (ideally an eng contact)?
2) Confirm sandbox credentials timeline (we called out 8/19 as ideal)
3) Rishi — can you confirm feasibility for the 9/18 target given our current backlog?
4) I'll schedule a 30-min sync next week to walk the MAP and sample code.

Attachments: acme_map_integration_build_plan_v1.pdf (MAP draft), sdk_requirements.xlsx (fields for SDK + test cases)

Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEFgMapDraft

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Ethan Brown <ethan.brown@acmetech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Tech Pre-Sales <presales@acmetech.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, Streaming, Tool Calling) - Draft

Marissa —

Appreciate the detailed draft and the call yesterday. This looks good overall. Quick confirmations and a couple of asks from our side:

- Owners: I (Ethan) will be the Acme program owner. I'll loop in our lead engineer, Sofia Reyes, to the thread once I have internal signoff (she's currently out until Monday). For now, please assign "Acme eng lead" to my name in the MAP.
- Sandbox/credentials: We can provision a read-only sandbox by 8/20; we need to coordinate on allowed IPs (our infra team restricts egress).
- Streaming: Can you confirm whether Redwood's recommended approach is websocket-based streaming or SSE for low-latency token streaming? We prefer websockets but want to ensure the SDK samples match.
- Tool calling: We like the calendar example — for production we'll want strict schema validation. Can you provide a sample JSON schema for the structured output?

Tentative: We can aim for the 9/18 POC integration milestone but would like to keep a soft target of 9/25 if we hit infra approval delays.

Let's do the 30-min sync next Tue (8/18) 10-10:30 PT if that works for your team.

Thanks,
Ethan Brown
Sr. Product Manager, Integrations | Acme Technologies
ethan.brown@acmetech.com
+1 (617) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Brown <ethan.brown@acmetech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, Streaming, Tool Calling) - Draft

Ethan —

Thanks for the quick responses and the availability. 8/18 10:00 PT works for us — I'll send a calendar invite to lock it. A few clarifications inline to address your asks:

- Streaming: Redwood supports both websockets and SSE. For low-latency token streaming to web clients we recommend websockets (example included in SDK sample). We'll include both examples in the repo; default sample will be websocket-based.
- Structured output schema: Attached is a lightweight JSON schema snippet in sdk_requirements.xlsx; we'll publish a canonical JSON schema in the shared Drive before the sync.
- Sandbox IPs: We'll need the list of Acme egress IPs to add to our dev allowlist. If Acme prefers, we can also put you behind a secure tunnel.
- Timeline: We can accept a soft target of 9/25 if infra gating pushes the POC out; will mark 9/18 as the committed target and 9/25 as contingency in the MAP.

Rishi — can you confirm the SDK bandwidth to produce Python + JS samples and a websocket streaming demo by 9/18 (soft target 9/25)? Also please call out any blocking dependencies from our infra/devops side (e.g., access to sandbox credentials, dev endpoint allowlist).

Ethan — invite is going out for 8/18 10-10:30 PT.

Best,
Marissa

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ethan Brown <ethan.brown@acmetech.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Integration Build Plan (SDK, Streaming, Tool Calling) - Draft

Marissa / Ethan —

Thanks — quick update from eng: we can own the SDK samples (Python + JS) and websocket streaming demo. Rough timeline: prototype samples by 9/3, internal QA by 9/10, partner-ready artifacts by 9/18. That fits the committed target.

Blocking items we need from Acme:
- Sandbox read-only API keys (provision by 8/20)
- Egress IP list or a short-lived SSH tunnel for initial testing
- Acceptance criteria doc with expected structured-output fields (we'll default to the schema in the attached spreadsheet if you don't provide).

I've attached a short dev checklist (sdk_requirements.xlsx) that maps features to owner and ETA. Also noted that tool-calling integration will need a simple webhook endpoint on Acme side for verification; if Acme can't expose a public endpoint we can run a proxy for the POC.

I'll be on the 8/18 sync to walk the sample flow.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Software Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: sdk_requirements.xlsx (dev checklist)
